text: ときには…　さきに　いけそうな　みちが　あったら　すすんで　みましょう！

structure.jp: さきに　いけそうな　みちが　あったら
structure.en: if there is a path that looks like it leads onward

structure.jp: すすんで　みましょう！

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう on the stem of a verb says it looks as if that would happen; with な it describes the next thing. いけそうな　みち = 'a path that looks like you can go along it'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. あったら = 'if there is'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: すすんで　みましょう
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with みる means to try doing something to see what happens. すすんで　みましょう = 'let's try going ahead'.
